content: fix this github ci error The job failed because of a Playwright selector issue in the E2E test, not because the app crashed or the login flow failed outright. What happened: - The failing test was: - User can sign in with valid credentials and sign out - In `e2e/tests/app.spec.ts:13`, the test does: - `await expect(page.getByText('demo.approver (Approver)')).toBeVisible();` - After login, the page contains the same text in two places: - `demo.approver (Approver)` - another element containing text like `Session: demo.approver (Approver)` - Because Playwright uses strict matching for `getByText`, it treats this as ambiguous and throws: - `strict mode violation: getByText('demo.approver (Approver)') resolved to 2 elements` - `expect(locator).toBeVisible() failed` This caused the single test to fail, and since the overall CI step exits non-zero when any test fails, the job failed with exit code 1. Evidence from the logs: - `4 passed (11.6s)` - `1 failed` - failing test: `[chromium] › tests/app.spec.ts:6:7 › Invoice App Workflows › User can sign in with valid credentials and sign out` In short: the login succeeded, but the test’s locator was too broad/ambiguous because the user name appeared twice on the page.
summary: User request: fix this github ci error
